answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 29260 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it permissible to delete sms messages contains quranic verses or entire Surah. b/c we sometime carry mobile in bathrooms where it is not allowed at all. Pl help. Question: Is it permissible to delete sms messages contains quranic verses or entire Surah. b/c we sometime carry mobile in bathrooms where it is not allowed at all. Pl help. Answer ID: 29260 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 170/170/M=1432) One should avoid writing Quranic verses in the mobile. You can delete SMSs containing Quranic verses if needed, rather it is better to delete them in order to save them from desecration. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
